name: inbox_triage_to_project_and_tasks
description: Email side, chained into the project side. analyze_inbox returns unassigned emails with a suggested project; the tasks created afterwards must take their text FROM those emails via from_step, not from the model's idea of what an email probably said.

turns.message: Revisame la bandeja, mira si hay algo sin asignar que pinte de Farmacia Haussman, asignalo al proyecto y creame una tarea por cada correo con el asunto del correo como texto de la tarea
turns.why: The task text is explicitly defined as the email subject, so it IS derivable -- from step 1. Anything else in that field is invented.

assert.comment: If no unassigned email matches, the correct answer is 'there is nothing', not three generic tasks.
